body:
## Summary
- Add `dolphin_cfg.py`: patches/reverts `RetroAchievements.ini`'s `[Achievements]` section (`HostUrl`, `HardcoreEnabled`) on ROCKNIX, mirroring the existing `ppsspp_cfg.py`/`batocera_conf.py` pattern.
- Extend Smart Cache to discover recently played GameCube/Wii games: scans `.gci` memory-card saves and Wii NAND disc-title save folders by mtime, matched against a game-code library built by reading the disc header of `.rvz`/`.wia`/`.iso`/`.gcm` ROM files under Dolphin's configured ISO search paths.
- Wire both into `main.py` (CLI `start-proxy`/`stop-proxy`) and `menu_sdl.py` (the on-device UI's inline start/stop).

## Depends on
This currently has no effect on-device until ROCKNIX ships [ROCKNIX/distribution#3038](https://github.com/ROCKNIX/distribution/pull/3038), since standalone Dolphin's `cheevos_dolphin.sh` fully regenerates `RetroAchievements.ini` on every game launch with no `HostUrl` field — our patch would otherwise be silently wiped before the game session starts. See [misantronic/RAOfflineProxy#33](https://github.com/misantronic/RAOfflineProxy/issues/33) for full context and tracking.

Verified end-to-end (login2 → achievementsets → startsession → awardachievement, all through the local proxy, game cached) using a temporary bind-mount of the patched `cheevos_dolphin.sh` over the real system path — not merged into this PR, that test rig only existed for validation.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3 -m pytest linux/tests/` — 327 passed, 11 skipped (pre-existing, unrelated)
- [x] Verified real end-to-end achievement flow on ROCKNIX hardware via a temporary local test rig (see above)
- [ ] Re-verify without the test rig once ROCKNIX/distribution#3038 merges and ships in a release
title: Add Dolphin support for ROCKNIX
